C01.name: object level authorisation
C01.desc: per object ownership check on every operation

C02.name: function level authorisation
C02.desc: per operation role and permission check, deny by default

C03.name: binding allowlist
C03.desc: explicit field allowlist, never object hydration

C04.name: identity canonicalisation
C04.desc: one normalisation form, exact match, verified linking

C05.name: state machine integrity
C05.desc: invariants enforced per step, separation of duties

C06.name: credential and token policy
C06.desc: atomic single use, subset scopes, verified identity

C07.name: parser strictness
C07.desc: one parser, reject duplicates and alternates

C08.name: path and namespace control
C08.desc: canonicalise once, verify containment, no user paths

C09.name: cache and key discipline
C09.desc: every varying input in the key

C10.name: cost and resource control
C10.desc: per operation cost and quotas by principal

C11.name: audit integrity
C11.desc: structured append only logging with attribution

C12.name: protocol lifecycle
C12.desc: retired versions decommissioned, one policy point

note: If you have class C, these patterns die. This is the defender facing view of the atlas.
